sentence: The manager asked all employees to ___________ the new safety guidelines carefully before starting work.
explanation_zh: "ask someone to V" 的句型中,to 後面須接原形動詞,所以用 review,而非 reviewing、reviewed 或 reviews。

sentence: By the time the client arrives tomorrow morning, the sales team ___________ the final proposal.
explanation_zh: by the time + 未來時間子句,主句常用未來完成式表示「在某未來時間點之前已完成」,故用 will have finished。

sentence: The technician is responsible for ___________ the equipment every month.
explanation_zh: 介系詞 for 後面須接動名詞(V-ing)作受詞,所以是 inspecting,而不能用原形動詞 inspect 或不定詞 to inspect。

sentence: After ___________ the contract twice, the lawyer finally signed it.
explanation_zh: After 在此作介系詞,後面接動名詞 reviewing,表示「在複閱合約兩次之後」。

sentence: The shipment, ___________ by the warehouse staff yesterday, arrived at the store this morning.
explanation_zh: 此處為分詞子句,shipment 與 inspect 是被動關係(貨物被檢查),故用過去分詞 inspected,相當於 which was inspected。

sentence: The company plans to ___________ its product line by the end of next year.
explanation_zh: plan to V 為固定用法,to 後面須接原形動詞 expand。

sentence: Ms. Carter has ___________ in the finance department for over a decade.
explanation_zh: for + 一段時間,搭配 has,表示現在完成式,動詞須用過去分詞 worked。

sentence: While ___________ the annual report, the accountant noticed several discrepancies.
explanation_zh: While 引導的分詞構句省略主詞與 be 動詞時,動詞須用現在分詞 preparing,表示主動進行「準備報告」的動作。

sentence: Each of the applicants ___________ required to submit a résumé and two references.
explanation_zh: "Each of + 複數名詞" 視為單數概念,動詞須用單數形式 is。

sentence: The list of new employees ___________ posted on the bulletin board every Monday.
explanation_zh: 句子主詞是單數的 list,「of new employees」只是修飾語,動詞須配合 list 用單數 is。

sentence: Neither the manager nor the assistants ___________ available to answer questions today.
explanation_zh: neither A nor B 的句型中,動詞須與最接近的主詞一致,此處最近的是複數的 assistants,故用 are。

sentence: The number of complaints ___________ decreased significantly since the new policy took effect.
explanation_zh: "The number of + 複數名詞" 視為單數,動詞須用單數 has,不同於 "A number of" 視為複數。

sentence: A number of customers ___________ requested refunds this week.
explanation_zh: "A number of + 複數名詞" 表示「許多」,視為複數,動詞須用 have。

sentence: Everyone in the office ___________ invited to the retirement party on Friday.
explanation_zh: 不定代名詞 everyone 視為單數,動詞須用 is。

sentence: The committee ___________ divided over whether to approve the budget increase.
explanation_zh: committee 為集合名詞,在此強調整體為一單位意見分歧,動詞用單數 is。

sentence: All of the documents in the folder ___________ ready for the audit.
explanation_zh: "All of + 複數名詞" 中,documents 為複數,動詞須用 are。

sentence: The ___________ of the new marketing strategy exceeded everyone's expectations.
explanation_zh: 空格為句子主詞,須用名詞 success,而 succeed 是動詞、successful 是形容詞、successfully 是副詞,皆不符文法。

sentence: Employees must obtain written ___________ before taking time off during the holiday season.
explanation_zh: written 為形容詞,後面須接名詞 approval,表示「書面核准」。

sentence: The ___________ between the two departments improved after the workshop.
explanation_zh: 空格為句子主詞,須用名詞 cooperation(合作),而非動詞 cooperate、形容詞 cooperative 或副詞 cooperatively。

sentence: The company offered a generous ___________ package to attract experienced engineers.
explanation_zh: 空格在形容詞 generous 之後、名詞 package 之前,須用名詞 compensation 修飾 package,構成複合名詞。

sentence: Customer ___________ is the top priority for our support team.
explanation_zh: 空格與 customer 組成複合名詞作句子主詞,須用名詞 satisfaction,而非動詞 satisfy 或分詞形容詞 satisfied/satisfying。

sentence: The firm's ___________ in renewable energy has grown steadily over the past five years.
explanation_zh: the firm's 為所有格,後面須接名詞 investment 作主詞,而非動詞 invest 或其變化形。

sentence: The manager requested a detailed ___________ of the quarterly results.
explanation_zh: detailed 為形容詞修飾名詞,空格須用名詞 explanation,而非動詞 explain 或其分詞形式。

sentence: The ___________ of the new software led to a significant increase in productivity.
explanation_zh: 空格為句子主詞,須用名詞 implementation(實施),而非動詞 implement 或其分詞形式。

sentence: The new intern completed the assignment ___________ despite having little experience.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾動詞 completed,須用副詞 efficiently,而非形容詞 efficient 或名詞 efficiency。

sentence: The proposal submitted by the marketing team was ___________ detailed and well organized.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 detailed,須用副詞 extremely,而非形容詞 extreme 或名詞 extremity/extremeness。

sentence: The negotiations proceeded ___________ once both sides agreed on the terms.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾動詞 proceeded,須用副詞 smoothly,而非形容詞 smooth 或名詞 smoothness。

sentence: It is ___________ important to double-check all figures before submitting the report.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 important,須用副詞 highly,而非形容詞 high 或名詞 height。

sentence: The manager reviewed the budget ___________ before presenting it to the board.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾動詞 reviewed,須用副詞 carefully,而非形容詞 careful 或名詞 care/carefulness。

sentence: Despite the ___________ weather, the outdoor conference proceeded as scheduled.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾名詞 weather,須用形容詞 unpredictable,而非副詞 unpredictably 或名詞 unpredictability。

sentence: The new policy was ___________ received by most staff members.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾被動語態動詞 was received,須用副詞 positively,而非形容詞 positive 或名詞 positivity。

sentence: Customers found the checkout process ___________ simple and convenient.
explanation_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 simple,須用副詞 remarkably,而非形容詞 remarkable 或名詞 remark。

sentence: The quarterly meeting has been rescheduled ___________ Thursday afternoon.
explanation_zh: reschedule something to + 新時間,表示「改期到」,故用 to,而 at/in/on 用於描述原本的時間點,不符合改期的語意。

sentence: The invoice must be submitted ___________ the end of the month to ensure timely payment.
explanation_zh: by 表示「最晚不超過某期限」,符合「月底前繳交」的語意;until 強調動作持續到某時間點,不符合此處「繳交」這種瞬間動作。

sentence: The new regulations will take effect ___________ January 1st.
explanation_zh: 特定日期前須用介系詞 on,故用 on January 1st,而非 at(用於時刻)或 in(用於月份、年份)。

sentence: All visitors must sign in ___________ the front desk before entering the office.
explanation_zh: 表示某個具體地點(定點)時用 at,故用 at the front desk。

sentence: The delivery was delayed ___________ unexpected weather conditions.
explanation_zh: due to 為介系詞片語,後接名詞片語表示原因;despite 表讓步、unless 與 although 是連接詞須接子句,皆不符合此處接名詞片語的用法。

sentence: The report should be handed in ___________ Friday at the latest.
explanation_zh: by 表示「最晚在星期五之前」交出報告,符合期限的語意。

sentence: The workshop is designed ___________ new managers who need training in leadership skills.
explanation_zh: be designed for + 對象,表示「為……而設計」,故用 for。

sentence: The negotiations continued ___________ midnight before an agreement was reached.
explanation_zh: until 表示動作持續到某時間點為止,符合「談判持續到午夜」的語意,而 by 強調期限而非持續。

sentence: The flight was delayed for several hours; ___________, passengers were offered complimentary meals.
explanation_zh: 前後句為因果關係(航班延誤,因此提供免費餐點作為補償),須用表示結果的連接副詞 therefore。

sentence: The proposal was well researched; ___________, the board rejected it due to budget constraints.
explanation_zh: 前後句語意轉折(研究充分卻仍被拒絕),須用表示對比的連接副詞 however。

sentence: ___________ the heavy rain, the outdoor event proceeded as planned.
explanation_zh: 空格後接名詞片語 the heavy rain,須用介系詞性連接詞 despite,而 although/because/since 之後須接完整子句。

sentence: ___________ sales increased last quarter, profits remained flat due to rising costs.
explanation_zh: 空格後接完整子句(sales increased...),須用連接詞 although,而 despite/because of/due to 之後須接名詞片語。

sentence: The company increased its marketing budget; ___________, sales did not improve as expected.
explanation_zh: 前後句語意轉折(增加預算卻銷售未提升),須用表示讓步轉折的連接副詞 nevertheless。

sentence: The manager praised the team's effort; ___________, she pointed out areas for improvement.
explanation_zh: 前句稱讚、後句指出待改進之處,語意轉折,須用 however。

sentence: The machine passed all safety tests; ___________, it was approved for use on the production line.
explanation_zh: 前後句為因果關係(通過測試,因此獲准使用),須用表示結果的連接副詞 consequently。

sentence: ___________ the shipment arrives on time, the product launch will proceed as scheduled.
explanation_zh: Provided that 表示條件,相當於 if,後接子句,符合「只要貨物準時送達」的語意;despite/in spite of 之後須接名詞片語。

sentence: Please make sure to bring ___________ own laptop to the training session.
explanation_zh: 空格後接名詞 laptop,須用所有格形容詞 your,而 yours 是所有格代名詞(單獨使用,不接名詞)。

sentence: The director reviewed the report ___________ before approving the final version.
explanation_zh: 此處用強調用法的反身代名詞 himself,強調「總監親自」複閱報告。

sentence: If the new printer breaks down again, we will have to replace it with ___________.
explanation_zh: another 表示「另一個(同類但非特定的)」,用於泛指再換一台新印表機;the other 則用於限定為「兩者中的另一個」,不符合此處語意。

sentence: Of the two suppliers we contacted, one offered a discount, but ___________ did not.
explanation_zh: 談到兩者中的「一個…另一個」時,第二個須用 the other,表示剩下唯一確定的那一個。

sentence: The employees were asked to submit ___________ timesheets no later than Friday.
explanation_zh: 空格後接名詞 timesheets,須用所有格形容詞 their,而 theirs 是所有格代名詞,不可直接修飾名詞。

sentence: This desk is mine, and that one over there is ___________.
explanation_zh: 空格單獨作補語,不接名詞,須用所有格代名詞 yours,而 your 是所有格形容詞須接名詞。

sentence: Some customers prefer online support, while ___________ still call the help desk directly.
explanation_zh: 與前面的 some 相對應,表示「另一部分不特定的人」,須用代名詞 others,而 other 須接名詞、the other 限定為剩下唯一的一個。

sentence: The consultants provided the company with advice that proved invaluable to ___________ long-term strategy.
explanation_zh: 空格指的是前面提到的 the company(單數),須用所有格形容詞 its,而非指顧問們的 their,it's 則是 it is 的縮寫,文法上不可修飾名詞。

sentence: This year's sales figures are ___________ than last year's.
explanation_zh: 句尾有 than,須用比較級 higher,而非原級 high 或最高級 highest。

sentence: Of all the candidates interviewed, Ms. Lin had the ___________ qualifications.
explanation_zh: of all the candidates 表示三者以上的比較,須用最高級 the most impressive。

sentence: The new machine operates ___________ efficiently than the old one.
explanation_zh: 多音節副詞 efficiently 的比較級須加 more,並搭配句尾的 than 使用。

sentence: The sooner the report is submitted, the ___________ the team can begin the review.
explanation_zh: "The + 比較級..., the + 比較級..." 為對等比較句型,前後都須用比較級,故用 sooner。

sentence: This model is far ___________ expensive than the previous version, yet it offers better features.
explanation_zh: far 用來加強比較級語氣,搭配 than 使用,須用比較級 less(較不…),而非最高級 least 或用於可數名詞的 fewer/few。

sentence: Among all the branches, the downtown office generates the ___________ revenue.
explanation_zh: among all the branches 表示三者以上的比較,須用最高級 the most,修飾不可數名詞 revenue。

sentence: As the deadline approaches, employees are working ___________ than usual.
explanation_zh: 句尾有 than usual,須用比較級 harder,而非原級 hard 或最高級 hardest。

sentence: The two proposals are almost identical, but this one is slightly ___________ detailed.
explanation_zh: 多音節形容詞 detailed 的比較級須加 more,slightly 修飾比較級表示「些微地」。

sentence: The employee ___________ proposal won the innovation award works in the R&D department.
explanation_zh: 空格後接名詞 proposal,表示「該員工的提案」,須用所有格關係代名詞 whose。

sentence: The report, ___________ was submitted late, contained several errors.
explanation_zh: 逗號隔開的非限定用法子句,先行詞為事物 report,須用 which,that 通常不用於非限定用法逗號子句。

sentence: The consultant ___________ we hired last month has already improved our workflow.
explanation_zh: 先行詞 consultant 是人,且在子句中作受詞(we hired 顧問),正式用法須用受格關係代名詞 whom。

sentence: This is the department ___________ handles all customer complaints.
explanation_zh: 先行詞 department 是事物,且在子句中作主詞,須用 that(或 which),whom 用於人、whose 為所有格、what 不可接先行詞。

sentence: Employees ___________ contracts expire this month should contact HR immediately.
explanation_zh: 空格後接名詞 contracts,表示「員工的合約」,須用所有格關係代名詞 whose。

sentence: The building ___________ the company is located was constructed in 1998.
explanation_zh: 先行詞 building 為地點,子句中缺少地方副詞而非受詞,須用關係副詞 where。

sentence: The reason ___________ the shipment was delayed remains unclear.
explanation_zh: 先行詞 reason 表示原因,須用關係副詞 why 引導子句說明原因。

sentence: The manager, ___________ has worked here for fifteen years, will retire next month.
explanation_zh: 逗號隔開的非限定用法子句,先行詞 manager 是人且在子句中作主詞,須用 who。

sentence: The company adopted a more ___________ approach to manufacturing in order to cut costs.
explanation_zh: economical 表示「節省成本、經濟實惠的」,符合此處語意;economic 表示「與經濟學/經濟有關的」,economy 和 economics 為名詞,不可修飾名詞 approach,是常見的字義混淆考點。

sentence: The two managers submitted their reports on Monday and Wednesday, ___________.
explanation_zh: respectively 表示「依序、分別」,用來對應前面提到的兩個時間;respectfully 表示「恭敬地」,意思完全不同,是常見的字義混淆考點。

sentence: Only ___________ staff members are permitted to access the server room.
explanation_zh: authorized 表示「獲得授權的」,符合語意;authoritative 表示「具權威性的、可靠的」,authoritarian 表示「獨裁的」,意思皆不同,屬於易混淆的字義選擇題。

sentence: The HR department keeps all ___________ files in a locked cabinet.
explanation_zh: personnel 作形容詞時指「人事的、員工的」,personal 則指「個人的、私人的」,兩字意思不同,是常見的字義混淆考點。

sentence: Visitors are asked to observe the company's basic safety ___________ before entering the factory floor.
explanation_zh: principles 指「原則」(複數),符合語意;principals 指「校長、負責人或本金」,兩字發音相同但意思完全不同,是常見的同音異義混淆詞。

sentence: The renovation project required a ___________ amount of time and money.
explanation_zh: considerable 表示「相當大的、可觀的」,符合語意;considerate 表示「體貼的、考慮周到的」,兩字意思不同,容易混淆。

sentence: The factory experienced ___________ power outages throughout the week, with several brief interruptions each day.
explanation_zh: continual 指「反覆發生、間歇性的」,符合此處停電多次發生而非完全不間斷的語意;continuous 指「不間斷、持續的」,兩字意思不同。

sentence: Hotel guests receive a ___________ breakfast as part of their stay.
explanation_zh: complimentary 表示「免費贈送的」,符合語意;complementary 表示「互補的」,兩字發音相近但意思不同,是常見的字義混淆考點。
